title: Finding a Right-Inverse Function Under Composition
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Let f(x) = x / (x - 2). Find a function y = g(x) so that the composite function satisfies (f o g)(x) = x.

steps.title: Set Up the Composition Equation f(g(x)) = x
steps.explanation: Replace x in the formula for f(x) with the unknown function g(x) and equate the resulting expression to x.
steps.why: By definition of function composition, (f o g)(x) = x means f(g(x)) = x.

steps.title: Clear the Denominator and Group Terms in g(x)
steps.explanation: Multiply both sides by g(x) - 2, expand the right-hand side, and collect all terms containing g(x) on one side of the equation.
steps.why: Linearly isolating g(x) allows us to solve explicitly for g(x) in terms of x.

steps.title: Solve for g(x) and Verify the Composition
steps.explanation: Divide by x - 1 (for x != 1) to obtain g(x) = 2x / (x - 1), and substitute back into f to verify that f(g(x)) simplifies identically to x.
steps.why: Direct substitution confirms that g(x) = 2x/(x - 1) satisfies (f o g)(x) = x.
